coach.safetyNote: General fitness support, not medical advice. For pain, injury, pregnancy or any health concern, please see a doctor.
coach.contextNote: The coach sees your goal, equipment, body weight, recent check-in numbers and upcoming plan days. It never sees your photos, name or email.

buddy.intro: A private group of people you invite. Nobody else can find it.
